v1alpha1.description: KusoCron schedules a recurring job — typically `rails runner …` / `manage.py …` against a service's image.

activeDeadlineSeconds.description: Hard kill after N seconds. 0 = no limit.

command.description: argv for the job container. Required for kind=service and kind=command; ignored for kind=http (chart synthesises curl args).

displayName.description: Free-form label shown in the UI. Optional; falls back to the cron's short name.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: control-plane secrets (kuso-*) cannot be mounted into workload pods

kind.description: Disambiguates the cron flavour. service=run a parent service's image; http=curl a URL; command=run a user-supplied image with argv. Empty defaults to service for back-compat.

onFailure.description:
Optional notification hook fired when a scheduled Job
exits non-zero. The cron watcher POSTs a JSON body
`{project, service, cron, jobName, exitCode,
startedAt, finishedAt, logsURL}` to webhookURL. When
secretRef is set, the body is HMAC-SHA256 signed
with the secret's value under the
`X-Kuso-Signature` header.

Without this, a silently-failing cron only surfaces
in the deployments tab — users with reminders,
refund deadlines, or expiry sweeps want active
alerting.

secretRef.description: Reference to a Secret whose value is the HMAC signing key.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: control-plane secrets (kuso-*) cannot be referenced from workload CRs

webhookURL.description: HTTPS endpoint to POST failure events to.

pinImage.description:
When false (the default) the cron FOLLOWS its parent service: every successful build repoints spec.image at the newly promoted tag. When true the image is frozen at whatever it is now and only an explicit `kuso cron sync` moves it.
Following is the default because a pinned cron silently rots — it keeps working until the weekly registry GC reaps its tag, then fails ImagePullBackOff on every fire while the service itself is healthy on a newer build. Pin deliberately, when a job must run a known-good image rather than whatever shipped that day.
Ignored for kind=command crons, which carry their own image by contract and never follow a service.

service.description: For kind=service only. KusoService FQN (e.g. <project>-<short>) whose image + envFromSecrets we reuse.

url.description: For kind=http only. Target URL — the cron fails on a non-2xx response.
